facts.title: Coffee Chocolate Chip Blondies
ingredients: 1 ½ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour (Sarah used all-purpose)
2 cups packed coconut sugar, or 1 ½ cups packed brown sugar
2 tablespoons strong coffee or cold brew concentrate, room temperature
¾ cup bittersweet or semisweet chocolate chips
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
